about.title: About Illumineer’s Quest: Palace Heist
paragraphs: Illumineer’s Quest: Palace Heist is a Disney Lorcana co-operative boxed game, released on 6 June 2025. Its checklist has the 35 cards numbered 1/35 to 35/35.

The box also has 4 bonus cards numbered in booster sets, so they’re in those sets’ checklists: Bolt - Superdog (Archazia’s Island 223/204), Goofy - Groundbreaking Chef (Reign of Jafar 223/204), Elsa - Ice Maker (Archazia’s Island 224/204) and Pinocchio - Strings Attached (Reign of Jafar 224/204).
This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details come from LorcanaJSON, card images from Lorcast and prices from TCGplayer.
